title: Photo library settings: stale refreshes overwrite newer state (flaky photo-library e2e)
description: From #52. refresh() responses can land out of order: the onMount refresh can overwrite add()'s, hiding the new source; a scan's refresh can revert an optimistic album toggle. photo-library.e2e fails ~1 in 2 full runs on main. Discard stale refreshes with a generation counter; e2e must wait for the scan to finish (not match 'scanned' already on screen).

title: Fix main: calendar-view e2e events wiped by calendar-settings Sync now
description: Main red since #49/#51: tests/e2e/calendar-view week test finds no .bar. seedCalendar's e2e-cal-source has calendars '[]', so any syncAll (calendar-settings 'Sync now' in the other project's worker) deletes its events: diffEvents drops rows whose calendar is not selected. Fix the fixture: declare a selected calendar and scope event external ids to it, so a failed sync (no credentials) leaves them.

title: Commit drizzle/meta/0000_snapshot.json (needs large-pr label)
description: PR #15 omitted the 1021-line drizzle-kit snapshot to stay under the size limit. Without it, the next db:generate recreates every table. Copy saved at scratchpad 0000_snapshot.json; regenerate with pnpm db:generate if missing. Needs a human large-pr label. Do before any further schema change.

title: HANDOFF: tashner-home-hub
description:
Living session handoff note. Never close (docs-only PRs use 'Refs hub-nni').

Lead session: main checkout session owns merges + beads export; user authorized lead to merge worker PRs using judgment + CI.
On main (2026-10-16 11:15 UTC): foundation + Tier1 CI, compose, secrets/LAN-only, kiosk scripts, design system, DB, backups, app shell, settings menu, profiles, PIN, first-run setup, rewards+goals, star ledger, chore model + admin, kid chores screen, parent approvals, calendar engine + agenda/week/month, ICS + iCloud + Google connectors, calendar settings + reauth, celebrations, offline SW + queued kid taps, photo cache + folder source + photo library settings, undo completion (kid 10s + adult list), goal jar + earned celebration, Lock button, idle timers (home 2m, frame 5m -> /photos).
In flight (agents, 2026-10-16): hub-6h8.4 slideshow (/photos), hub-sps.7 child switcher, hub-ek2.6 household TZ.
Waiting on the user: #13 human-approved (braces audit exception); hub-8lc.10 large-pr (drizzle snapshot - schema frozen); human-approved for e2e-port, photos-path rule, GHCR publish; ADR 0001 amendment (fetch vs googleapis); `bd dolt push` from a machine with GitHub access (cloud session policy 403s refs/dolt/data); stale remote branch feat/sign-out can be deleted.
Needs real accounts after deploy: Google consent + token lifetime, iCloud per-user host redirect.
Lessons: branch protection is strict (up to date with main) -> merge one PR at a time: update branch, wait CI, merge. e2e projects share one DB + server in parallel: unique ids per project, never global actions (sync-all, global settings) other tests depend on; rm -rf data before local full runs. Write txns are IMMEDIATE by default (openDb). Client refreshes must drop stale answers. Cloud container: export PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH for Node 24; flock /tmp/claude-0/e2e.lock around playwright (port 4173 shared). celebrate-perf can miss its budget under local load (green in CI).
Next: merge in-flight PRs as green; then phone polish (hub-5fd.6), portrait layouts + orientation (hub-5fd.4), admin UI (hub-ea5.3), sound settings, header badge for reached goals (hub-6tv.4), redemption (hub-6tv.3), Pi display agent after bench test (hub-8lc.9 needs hardware).
Updated: 2026-10-16, lead session.

title: Server SQLite connection has no busy_timeout: 'database is locked' under concurrent writers
description: Found by hub-ea5.6 worker: celebrate.e2e failed with SqliteError: database is locked at ledger.ts:108 while e2e helpers wrote to data/hub.db directly. src/lib/server/db/index.ts sets no busy_timeout, so any concurrent writer (backup job, scheduler, e2e helper) can fail a kid tap. Add pragma busy_timeout (e.g. 5000) on the server connection; consider BEGIN IMMEDIATE for write transactions.

title: Week view readability and tap targets
description: From PR #38 review (cal-week-land-day.png): titles clipped (Brunch, Socc, '9:...'), 30-min events ~30px tall and all-day bars 48px — below the 60px tap rule. Options: taller hour rows with the grid scrolling to now, minimum event height that fits time+title on one line, tapping a day column opens that day's agenda, title-first layout. Must be readable from across the room in landscape 2560x1440.

title: Chore admin page /settings/chores (branch feat/chore-admin-ui)

title: Narrow private-data photos/ path rule so src/routes/photos is allowed
description: scripts/ci/private-data.mjs forbids any path matching (^|/)photos/, which blocks legitimate route dirs (PR #18 had to serve /photos via a [section] param route). Restrict to real-data locations (e.g. ^photos/, ^data/, fixtures with real images) and keep the EXIF check for all images. Protected -> needs human-approved. Then move /photos to src/routes/(app)/photos/.

title: Set adapter-node ORIGIN for plain-http LAN (form actions 403)
description: adapter-node assumes https when ORIGIN/PROTOCOL_HEADER unset, so SvelteKit's CSRF check rejects same-origin form POSTs over http://hub.local:3000 (found in PR #19). Add HUB_ORIGIN to .env.example and ORIGIN=${HUB_ORIGIN} in compose.yaml; document that the kiosk and phones must use that exact URL. Do not disable csrf.checkOrigin.
close_reason: Completed in PR #25 (JSON fetch convention; adapter-node 6 has no runtime ORIGIN)
